channel.title: TuneCue
channel.description: Stage MIDI control for Auto-Tune in UAD Console

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
What changed

Stage starts empty so you add the presets you actually use. The status line reads READY, with the detail on hover. BYPASS and the new MIDI hold button stop blinking. The mini panel keeps its caption when a cue is pressed. The phone remote carries the TuneCue lockup.
